title: The Old Box Search
question: 把今天的“期待找到值钱东西 -> 用工具认真检查 -> 结果很小 -> 仍然保留希望”放进家里的旧铁盒场景：用 word bank 补完整 5 个空。
example_answer: Dreams of finding lost treasure almost came true. I found an old tin box in the cupboard. I used a flashlight to detect something inside it. Very excited, I opened the box. I finally found a small game coin. It was almost worthless. In spite of this, I am still confident that I may find something of value one day.
